info.name: CRM API - Complete Collection
info.description: Comprehensive Postman collection for all CRM APIs including Redtra Property Booking API, Core CRM APIs, and Lead Syncing APIs. This collection covers all routes exposed under crm.api.redtra.routes as well as all Core CRM endpoints and Lead Syncing functionality.
